name: AssDiction
source:
Steve one day sees more of his mom Megan than he should have and becomes addicted. With your right decisions everything goes uphill from there.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

Loosely adapted from Anal King's short story "[url=https://www.literotica.com/s/i-cant-make-it-without-moms-ass]I Can't Make It Without Mom's Ass[/url]", which also served as a basis for JABcomix comic book "[url=https://www.jabcomix.com/tour/comix/datass/datass.php]Dat Ass![/url]".
translation:
有一天，史蒂夫意外看到了不该看到的母亲梅根的身体，从此沉溺其中。只要做出正确选择，事情就会一路朝着更好的方向发展。

[编辑自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

大致改编自Anal King的短篇小说《[url=https://www.literotica.com/s/i-cant-make-it-without-moms-ass]我离不开妈妈的屁股[/url]》，该小说也是JABcomix漫画《[url=https://www.jabcomix.com/tour/comix/datass/datass.php]那个屁股！[/url]》的创作基础。
